facts.name: Ana Maria Garcia
facts.assignment: Profile states Jackson County Circuit. Published administrative procedures cover family law and criminal matters; no general commercial assignment inferred.

contact.contact_note: Shared office/assistant phone; no separate personal judge mailbox published.

stated_dates.meaning: Printed Revision Date 01/07/25; upload filename is not an effective date.

procedure_checklist.hearing_scheduling: Family matters: email assistant, copy opposing counsel, identify Jackson case number/style, motion and time needed; obtain confirmation before noticing. Jackson uses Central time. Notify assistant of cancellations.
procedure_checklist.chambers_communications: Use published assistant mailbox; omit assistant from counsel date-coordination chains. PDF page8 prints a truncated cancellation mailbox; profile and page2 provide full address.
procedure_checklist.proposed_orders: Family matters: circuit e-filing portal, Word order in DJCMA format and PDF cover letter identifying agreement. Submitting counsel serves persons not registered for portal service.
procedure_checklist.motion_submissions: Basic family scheduling/submission channels only; specialized motion and trial requirements not abstracted.
procedure_checklist.courtesy_copies: Family hearing materials: request OneDrive link from assistant copying other parties; do not email attachments. Source permits mailed hard copies received two business days before hearing when OneDrive is impossible.
procedure_checklist.remote_appearances: Family final hearings generally in person; others may use Zoom by all-party agreement. Request connection details from assistant and include them in notices. Source Zoom URL is malformed; preserved rather than silently repaired.
procedure_checklist.conferral: Family non-dispositive motions with counsel on both sides: source calls for good-faith conferral certificate. No general commercial rule inferred.

facts.review_scope: Official contact/assignment profile and directory; administrative procedure PDF collected complete, bounded review of family scheduling, submission and appearance channels (pages1–3,5–8). Criminal section collected, not substantively analyzed. Linked trial/pretrial order retained as official link only; no specialized family trial analysis.
